mapping.summary: Explainable demand forecasting and replenishment proposals per SKU for distributors.
claims: Calculates weekly usage, safety stock, target stock, EOQ and order now per item, variant and location
Uses measured lead times, purchase intervals and pack sizes
Planners accept, change or reject proposals with a reason; decisions are logged
Back-tests moving average, exponential smoothing, Holt-Winters and Croston per SKU and keeps the best
Can use BC time series models too
Writes to SKU planning fields and optionally demand forecast entries for MPS/MRP
Weekly projection gives first shortage date and latest order date
Respects minimum order value, multiples, weight, volume and container limits
Purchase proposals are created via the standard requisition worksheet
Forecast versions with approval and buyer-versus-system replay
Per-user plans with an approver-only tier and 30-day trial
